transcript.text: All you know how to do is hide. You hid behind a saxophone to try to escape your enemies,
you hid behind a pink dress and blonde wig, thinking that would make you popular and fitting,
and when that didn't work, you try to become this big, bad monster in a leather jacket with
red hair and face paint, thinking that somehow that would fix the broken girl you are inside.
You thought fighting everyone around you would somehow make you untouchable
until you came to NXT and you made a friend, and she broke down every single one of those walls
you spent so long putting up, and now you're doing the same thing again. You're hiding
behind the North American Championship, a championship I once held and will hold again
when the time is right. The Halloween habit? I'm gonna force you to face all the demons
you spent your whole life running from. The judgment, the loneliness, the insecurities,
and when all those demons try to tear you apart from the inside out,
I'll be there to take the only thing you have left to hide behind. And that just is what it is.
